Package edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services

Class BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services.BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllService
@Service public class BulkCitationUploadFromACMDLViewAllService extends Object
Parses the text ACM Digital Library's "Cited By > View All" page produces (an alternating sequence of one or more ACM-Ref-formatted citation lines, then the citing paper's https://doi.org/... link, repeated for each citing paper) and, for each DOI that passes a sanity check, resolves full metadata and adds a new BibTexEntry recording it as citing the current paper — so a user can paste ACM DL's whole "cited by" list at once instead of adding each citing paper one at a time.

Three things are flagged as errors rather than silently dropped or (worse) silently mis-added, per entry:

  • no DOI line follows the reference text at all (a trailing, unpaired block of text at the end of the pasted input) or the line doesn't parse as a DOI in any format DOIService recognizes;
  • the DOI doesn't resolve on any of CitationGraphService's tiered resolvers (the same waterfall — OpenAlex, then Semantic Scholar, then Crossref — used to fetch References/ Citations) — since building a BibTexEntry needs that metadata anyway, "no resolver has ever heard of this DOI" doubles as this feature's DOI-validity check, rather than a separate one;
  • the resolved title doesn't appear (case/punctuation-insensitive) anywhere in the paired reference text — catching a paste where the ACM-Ref/DOI pairing has drifted out of alignment (e.g. a stray blank line ACM DL didn't actually put there) before it silently attributes the wrong paper's citation.

A block of reference text with no title-bearing DOI to sanity-check it against (i.e. a standalone https://doi.org/... line with no preceding reference text) skips only that check, not the whole entry — the DOI itself still gets resolved and added normally.

Resolve-or-create-then-link reuses exactly the logic CitationGraphService uses for "Get Citations" (CitationGraphService.tryResolveByDoi(java.lang.String), CitationGraphService.tryRecoverMissingTitle(edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services.ResolvedWork, edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services.CitationMetadataResolver, edu.ucsb.cs156.jobs.services.JobContext), CitationGraphService.resolveOrCreateEntry(edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services.ResolvedWork, int, edu.ucsb.cs.citelines.services.CitationGraphService.ExistingEntries), CitationGraphService.saveCitationEdge(int, java.lang.String, java.lang.String)) rather than a second copy of it. A resolved DOI that turns out to be the current paper's own entry (e.g. ACM DL glitching a paper into its own "cited by" list) is skipped as an error rather than saved as a self-referential edge.
